headlines: US markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving; Friday half session (1pm ET close)
Stocklake snapshot unchanged since 14:09Z: SPY 720.43 (+0.23% incl. after-hours), QQQ 636.57, IWM +1.19%, TLT +0.66%, VIX 26.83, Fear & Greed 15 extreme fear
Bloomberg (via Stocktwits link): Trump calls revised GDP numbers fake, alleges purposeful under-reporting, calls for investigation
Bloomberg (via Stocktwits): Huawei preparing to release details of a new high-bandwidth memory chip it says could top Samsung and SK Hynix
Commerce Dept interim rule (Nov 17) requires licenses for advanced AI chip exports to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil; followed Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO
Next data: Tokyo CPI 23:30 UTC; French payrolls rev 07:45 UTC and German unemployment 08:55 UTC Fri
Stocktwits trending: VRTX (after-hours ~521 from 564), MO +1.95%, TXN +4.5%, EWZ +2.9%, CDE +5%, UCTT -2.4%, AMGN -1%

rumors.text: Nvidia ordered manufacturing partners to halt shipments of servers with its chips to Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia and Singapore
rumors.why: Likely a re-share of the Nov 17 US license rule for those countries; if a new company-level halt, it would hit AI server makers like SMCI

rumors.text: Huawei about to unveil an HBM chip that beats Samsung and SK Hynix, launching Chinese production despite sanctions
rumors.why: A credible Chinese HBM rival would pressure memory makers' pricing and US chip leadership narrative

rumors.text: Trump says revised GDP numbers are fake and calls for an investigation
rumors.why: Attacks on official data add policy uncertainty and could unsettle bond and equity markets

rumors.text: Big players coordinate to move SPY $20 in a morning
rumors.why: Manipulation claim; would mean higher intraday volatility, not a direction

rumors.text: Memory/chip selloff yesterday marked the bottom for now
rumors.why: A technical low in chips would support a relief bounce in the index

rumors.text: Trump is trying to engineer a year-end stock pump (carried over)
rumors.why: Policy jawboning aimed at stocks could fuel a December rally

rumors.text: Neocloud credit default swaps blowing out is the main bear catalyst for AI stocks (carried over)
rumors.why: Credit stress at AI cloud providers would renew pressure on chips

rumors.text: Inflation has peaked while economy runs hot, giving the Fed room (carried over)
rumors.why: Lower yields plus strong growth support a relief rally

plays.reason: Extreme fear (F&G 15), VIX easing, late quote above close and crowd only mildly bullish; thin half sessions tend to drift up, trimmed slightly for new chip/China headlines

readings.whats_new: Still closed; Stocklake numbers are the same 14:09Z snapshot (SPY now shown with after-hours, 720.43 +0.23%, not a new move). New Stocktwits talk: an Nvidia SE Asia server-shipment halt (looks like a re-share of the Nov 17 US license rule), a Bloomberg-sourced Huawei HBM chip story, and Trump calling the GDP revision fake. The earlier 'Jensen removal' rumor is dropped: web reports say Huang already resigned, so it is old news.
